notes: Vodalian Arcanist, printed: '{T}: Add {C}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). With {R} in the pool, Scorching Dragonfire ({1}{R}, an instant) is paid by the {R} and the Arcanist's {C}. The Dragonfire deals 3 to the opponent's 2/2, which is exiled instead of dying. Both mana spent, the Arcanist is tapped.
